sections.heading: Overview
bullets: Tank-and-spank with two shielded adds at 66%/33% and a repeating fixation mechanic. 11-minute enrage grants Samarog +500% damage — treat any enrage as a wipe.

sections.heading: Samarog's attacks
bullets: <mark>Bludgeon</mark> (commonly called "Shockwave"): an overhead spear slam with a knockback — jump or dodge it. The tank can stand in his hitbox and dodge/jump backward on impact; some defensive skills prevent the knockback outright.

<mark>Spear Impact</mark>: every 20s a red circle telegraphs a spear slam that hits hard on landing and leaves a damage-over-time hazard behind. Squads usually just cleave through spears while damaging the boss rather than dedicating time to destroying them (Challenge Mote: spears land every 5s in fixed patterns and can't be destroyed).

<mark>Inevitable Betrayal</mark>: every 25s two players are targeted — one gets a large orange circle, the other a small green one. They need to stack on each other or the orange-circle player takes heavy damage. Pull this pair away from the rest of the group so no one else eats the damage.

<mark>Brutalize</mark>: every 10% health, Samarog leaps onto the current tank, goes damage-immune, and gets a defiance bar — the rest of the squad needs to CC him to free the fixated player. Healing the fixated player buys more time to land the break. Fixation moves to the furthest player once it resolves.

sections.heading: Rigom & Guldhem (66% / 33%)
bullets: Two shielded adds spawn together — Rigom (smaller) and Guldhem (larger). Damage to Guldhem transfers to Rigom while his shield is up, so the real play is pushing Rigom underneath Samarog while the squad kills Guldhem.

If Rigom's explosion hits Samarog, Guldhem loses his shield — that's the window to actually burn him down. His shield comes back every 33% of his own health, so expect to repeat this a few times per split.
Ranger pets/specific pulls can wrangle Rigom solo; otherwise any CC or displacement skill helps move him.

sections.heading: Enrage
bullets: 11:00 — Samarog's damage jumps +500% past this point.

cmSections.heading: What's different in Challenge Mote
bullets: +10 million health on top of every attack hitting harder.

Spear Impact spawns every 5 seconds in a fixed pattern instead of on a timer, and the spears can't be destroyed — once all 12 have landed, Spear Return kicks in to start clearing them. The usable floor space keeps shrinking as the fight goes on.

Inevitable Betrayal is active from the very start of the fight (not just later), and the large-circle player can no longer move — their partner has to come to them instead. Each occurrence also drops an extra Spear Impact at that spot.
Net effect: constant repositioning with less and less room to do it in, especially during the Rigom/Guldhem splits where floor space was already tight.
